_comment: Psionic disciplines from PSIHELP.STR. Each tier has a Neural Capacity entry (must be bought first) followed by seven disciplines, in the order the Psi Upgrade Unit lays them out (two columns, left to right). 'maxPsiBonus' is the extra maximum psi points the tier's Neural Capacity grants. 'icon' is the PICNxx base name.

capacity.name: First Tier Neural Capacity
capacity.desc: This is required for First Tier psionic disciplines. It increases your maximum psi points by 2. All First Tier disciplines cost 1 psi point per use.

powers.name: Psycho-reflective Screen
powers.desc: Protects you from 15% of all combat damage.

powers.name: Neuro-reflex Dampening
powers.desc: Eliminates all weapon kickback.

powers.name: Kinetic Redirection
powers.desc: Pulls an object toward you.

powers.name: Psychogenic Agility
powers.desc: Increases your Agility by 2.

powers.name: Psychogenic Cyber Affinity
powers.desc: Increases your CYB by 2.

powers.name: Projected Cryokinesis
powers.desc: Launches a heat-draining projectile at a target. Higher PSI increases damage.

powers.name: Remote Electron Tampering
powers.desc: Makes active alarms time out faster.
powers.detail: Time Reduction: 5 seconds + 5 seconds per PSI

capacity.name: Second Tier Neural Capacity
capacity.desc: This is required for Second Tier psionic disciplines. It increases your maximum psi points by 4. All Second Tier disciplines cost 2 psi points per use.

powers.name: Anti-entropic Field
powers.desc: While this discipline is active, your ranged weapons cannot break, and their condition will not degrade.

powers.name: Adrenaline Overproduction
powers.desc: Increases hand-to-hand damage by a factor equal to PSI.

powers.name: Neural Decontamination
powers.desc: Shields you from 80% of radiation damage.

powers.name: Cerebro-stimulated Regeneration
powers.desc: Regenerates lost hit points.
powers.detail: Amount Healed: 2 hit points per PSI

powers.name: Psychogenic Strength
powers.desc: Increases your Strength by 2.

powers.name: Recursive Psionic Amplification
powers.desc: Increases your Psionics by 2. Psi point costs are doubled while active.

powers.name: Localized Pyrokinesis
powers.desc: Damages all creatures within a five foot radius. Higher PSI increases damage to enemies.

capacity.name: Third Tier Neural Capacity
capacity.desc: This is required for Third Tier psionic disciplines. It increases your maximum psi points by 6. All Third Tier disciplines cost 3 psi points per use.

powers.name: Molecular Duplication
powers.desc: Use some Nanites to duplicate one ammo clip or hypo.

powers.name: Electron Cascade
powers.desc: Recharges a single charged item or weapon.
powers.detail: Recharge amount: 20% per point of PSI, up to the maximum allowed by your Maintenance skill.

powers.name: Energy Reflection
powers.desc: Provides 50% immunity to all energy-based damage sources.

powers.name: Neural Toxin-blocker
powers.desc: Shields you from 100% of toxin absorption.

powers.name: Enhanced Motion Sensitivity
powers.desc: Shows the location of all nearby creatures.

powers.name: Projected Pyrokinesis
powers.desc: Launches a fiery projectile at a target. Higher PSI increases damage.

powers.name: Psionic Hypnogenesis
powers.desc: Target non-robotic creature will stand still and docile. If the creature takes damage, the effect ends.

capacity.name: Fourth Tier Neural Capacity
capacity.desc: This is required for Fourth Tier psionic disciplines. It increases your maximum psi points by 8. All Fourth Tier disciplines cost 4 psi points per use.

powers.name: Photonic Redirection
powers.desc: Renders you invisible to all creatures. Firing a weapon will end the effect.

powers.name: Remote Pattern Detection
powers.desc: Shows the location of many useful items, including nanites, ammo, hypos, implants and audio logs.

powers.name: Electron Suppression
powers.desc: Immobilizes any robotic target.

powers.name: Psychogenic Endurance
powers.desc: Increases your Endurance by 2.

powers.name: Molecular Transmutation
powers.desc: Turns ammunition and hypos into nanites.

powers.name: Remote Circuitry Manipulation
powers.desc: Allows you to hack psionically. Uses half your PSI stat (rounded up) in place of both Hacking skill and CYB stat, and costs psi points instead of nanites.

powers.name: Cerebro-energetic Extension
powers.desc: Turns your Psi-Amp into a powerful melee weapon.

capacity.name: Fifth Tier Neural Capacity
capacity.desc: This is required for Fifth Tier psionic disciplines. It increases your maximum psi points by 10. All Fifth Tier disciplines cost 5 psi points per use.

powers.name: Advanced Cerebro-stimulated Regeneration
powers.desc: Regenerates lost hit points.
powers.detail: Amount Healed: 5 hit points + 5 hit points per PSI

powers.name: Soma Transference
powers.desc: Drains target non-robotic creature of hit points, and adds those hit points to your total.

powers.name: Instantaneous Quantum Relocation
powers.desc: Teleports you to a marked location. If there is no marked location, this will set a marker at your current position.

powers.name: Imposed Neural Restructuring
powers.desc: Causes a non-robotic target to become hostile toward all non-human creatures.
powers.detail: Duration: 10 seconds per PSI, or until damaged by a human.

powers.name: Metacreative Barrier
powers.desc: Creates a wall of psionic force directly in front of you.
powers.detail: Wall's Hit Points: 150 + 50 per PSI over 5. Duration: 4 minutes

powers.name: External Psionic Detonation
powers.desc: Drops a psionic proximity mine. Does no damage to robots, and double damage to psionically sensitive creatures.

powers.name: Psycho-reflective Aura
powers.desc: Protects you from 60% of all combat damage.
